name: The Carver
description: a tall gaunt fussy demon of the Cracked Road who carves everything: pale grey basalt skin with thin orange seams, a long thin face with a disapproving frown, a stone chisel instead of a right hand, a mallet in the left hand, a little pair of spectacles, a neat leather apron dusty with rock

poses.stand: standing upright and stiff, chisel hand and mallet raised precisely
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: stands, peering through his spectacles, tutting, tapping the chisel with the mallet

attack.action: drives the chisel into the ground in front of him with a strike of the mallet, cracks shooting forward to the right

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
